biggest_catch: The friend must clear real hurdles - personal checking needs a $500 deposit plus 15 debit transactions within 60 days, and the referrer is paid only within 30 days after the friend finishes - so referrals of people who open an account and go quiet earn nothing.
catches: Referrer must register for the program (form, Digital Banking, or with a teammate) and share the offer via email, text, or social media.
Only one reward bonus per referred person; only the first referrer for a given person is eligible.

Personal Checking track: referred person must be a new C&N customer who opens a new personal checking account and, within 60 days of opening, deposits at least $500 AND completes 15 debit-card transactions (excluding ATM).
Personal Savings track: new C&N Key Savings account with a daily balance of $500+ maintained for 60 days.
Business Checking track: new business checking account with five deposits of $500+ each within 90 days; valid once per account.
Business Loan track: new business loan of $25,000+ opened and funded within 90 days (excludes business credit cards; loans subject to credit approval).
Maximum $500 in reward bonuses per calendar year per referrer.
Reward deposited into the referrer's sole- or joint-ownership account with the most recent transaction, within 30 days of the referred person meeting the qualifications.
Must be 18 or older; offer valid only for new C&N customers in the C&N Market Area; C&N employees are ineligible; bonuses may be reported as income to the IRS.
Offer can be changed or withdrawn at any time without notice.

steps: Register for C&N's Refer&Reward program via the form, C&N Digital Banking, or with a C&N teammate.
Share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers via email, text, or social media.
The referred person registers via your link and opens a new qualifying C&N account.
Personal Checking: friend deposits at least $500 and completes 15 debit-card transactions within 60 days. (Savings/business tracks have their own stated requirements.)
timing: The referrer receives the reward within 30 days of the referred person meeting the qualifications; the friend must complete qualifying activity within 60 days of account opening (90 days for business tracks).
